semantic_reason: The PR fixes a copy-paste typo in lib/cachex/router/ring/monitor.ex where `monitor_includes` was read instead of `monitor_excludes`, causing exclusion rules not to apply. This corrects existing behavior that produced an observed ETS badarg crash (issue #388) and is directly tied to the triggering test about ring router key routing with excluded nodes, not a new feature.
